facts.business: The company is engaged in the extraction of Edible Rice Bran Oil (ERBO) and Rice Bran Oil (RBO) from rice bran, along with production of de-oiled rice bran and other by-products.
key_risks: Inventory valuation involves significant judgment in cost allocation between joint products (ERBO, RBO, de-oiled rice bran) and quality/specification factors affecting realizable value.

High concentration of trade receivables with a single related party (E-Way Lipids Private Limited) accounting for 74% of total receivables, with 255% increase in receivables against 6.5% revenue growth and no allowance for expected credit losses on overdue amounts.
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables of Rs. 2,981.19 lakhs include Rs. 2,211.79 lakhs (74%) due from related party E-Way Lipids Private Limited. Purchases from related parties during the year. Refer Note 37.
